programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Gippsland, VIC - Part 1"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong embarks on an epic road trip through Central Gippsland, Victoria also known as The Middle of Everywhere. He learns how to forage for ingredients for a Wild Salad, harvest mushrooms and create spice blends from native ingredients.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Brooklyn"
programme.desc: Yann Horowitz skateboards with the KCDC skateboarding community in Brooklyn. Where he explores gaming, art and grilling with Crossy, Natalie, Jacob, Eddie and Nate, culminating in a joyful skate event showcasing community, inclusivity and fun.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "New Jersey"
programme.desc: Yann delves into New Jersey's skateboarding culture, meeting skateboarders who are into, fashion, horror, comedy, tattooing, and rug-making. He explores NJ Skate Shop and Freedom Skate Park, encountering Fred Gall and Brian Anderson.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture"
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Little Gems"
programme.desc: Modern city living has it challenges mostly around space. Johanna and Pete look at homes that make the most out of the space they have. These little gems may change the way you think about living in small spaces.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Coast"
programme.desc: After driving across the country, Lisa heads to Santa Monica to hang with a Hollywood producer and check out his pimped out Mercedes Benz G-Wagon. Lisa is welcomed into the school bus home of a family of 7! Because there is always room for one more.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: James returns to his former home city of Los Angeles, where he reconnects with old friends working in accessibility in the entertainment industry.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Seattle / Vancouver"
programme.desc: After a surprese invite to visit the head of accessibility at Microsoft's headquarters in Seattle, James heads to Vancouver, Canada's jewel of the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "New York City"
programme.desc: How does the bustling island of steel and stone fare for those with disabilities? James sets out to discover what it's like to travel blind in the Big Apple.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Cornwall"

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "St. Pete"
programme.desc: Marilia spreads love on her Treasure Island journey, capturing hidden gems from tranquil beaches to transformative sound healing. Meeting artists, experiencing Dolphin Yoga, participating in a flamenco dance class, and sharing a tea ceremony.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Joshua Tree"
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, Gabi shared astrology insights, Alchemy provided sound healing, and Marilia discovered spiritual connection. Guide Andrew introduced mindfulness, Doug showcased grounding through sprouting, concluding with reflection in hot springs.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Tokyo, Japan"

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Rotterdam, The Netherlands"
programme.desc: In the city of Rotterdam, three times world champion, Menno, hosts b-boy Junior from France. Both are considered legends. Menno takes Junior on a trip he will never forget and meet people who have all left their mark in the Dutch breaking community.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "NYC, USA"

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Philadelphia"

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "St. Petersburg"

programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 The Best Chefs of Modern Bangkok Part 3

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Foraging In Bali"
programme.desc: Sashi is exploring the hidden side of the famed paradise island, Bali. His guide and mentor for this episode is Chef Reynaldo de Luna - they’ve been on a foraging mission to uncover the biodiversity and hidden gems that Bali offers!

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Tofu"

programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong continues his road trip through The Middle Of Everywhere or Central Gippsland. From Locals he learns how to catch European carp for an ancient recipe for fish sauce and how to hunt and butcher wild deer.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Mallacoota, VIC"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong Travels to Mallacoota, Victoria to explore the seafood delicacies that the area has to offer but decides to make a few pitstops along the way. He learns how to make blue cheese and picks out some wine to match with seafood dishes.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Tasmania - Part 1"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong takes a ride on the Spirit of Tasmania to explore Northern Tasmania and tries hunting of a different kind, gets is hands dirty harvesting a local crop and gets an insight into cooking with a protein only available in Tasmania.

programme.title: Order Up! S1 - "Back to Basics"
programme.desc: Hudson starts his culinary journey in LA, learning from chef Kim Vu and celebrity chef Martin Yan. He covers the basics in the kitchen, sharpens his culinary skills, and creates an artistic dish for Randall Park and his ‘Fresh off the Boat’ co-stars.

programme.title: Order Up! S1 - "Fired Up"

programme.title: Order Up! S1 - "Cooking With Soul"
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Hudson learns about Creole & Cajun flavours from Li'l Dizzy's Cafe & Galatoire's fine dining restaurant. He must cook slowly but flawlessly, to make his own soul food creation, because today he is facing his toughest critic yet.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Antonin Bonnet – Quinsou"

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Clément Bouvier – Ursus"
programme.desc: In his quest to amaze his guests, Clément aims to always surprise, always exceed their expectations. By bringing the very forest to the table, both in his cuisine and in architecture, his visitors are in for a special and unique treat.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Hong Kong: Mixology"

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Dubai: 24 hour layover in the desert
programme.desc: Sashi is doing something he’s never done! A layover style episode. He’s got just 24 hours in the desert metropolis of Dubai. After seeking out the hive of human activity at Dubai’s bustling souks, Sashi does the absolute opposite, by venturing out in the desert.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S3 - "US Virgin Islands"
programme.desc: The US Virgin Islands is one of the most popular destinations in the Caribbean - how about their cuisine? With a true blue Jeep 4x4, Sashi explores the chains of islands, learning stories of local cuisines, brand new distilleries and much more

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - "Beijing"
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - "Beijing's Hutons"
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - "Changsha"
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province. They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why it's always attracting tourists.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is from California and he thinks he knows Mexican cuisine. This notion gets shattered as he experiences the onslaught of food in Mexico city! Between trying scorpion tacos and dodging shady markets in San Juan, he learns the dark art of sacred drinks, like pulque and mezcal, now turned into social libations. His journey also takes him to Oaxaca where he gets the low down on the fabled Mole sauce, and a long haul to a remote village reveals a secret ceremony that has origins of dark arts!

programme.title: Order Up! S1 - "Nose to Tail"
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, Hudson explores Nose to Tail dining where he learns to cook every part of an animal from bird to goat, facing lots of obstacles along the way. This sustainable way of cooking is definitely not for the squeamish, but it’s worth it.

programme.title: Order Up! S1 - "Using Your Noodle"

programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Mysore: The Rebel Kingdom
programme.desc: Journeys explores the history and fables that surround the controversial rebel leader Tipu Sultan. Mysore was the center of an Empire strong enough to challenge the British.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Nagarhole and Bandipur: The Southern Paradise of India"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Nagarhole and Bandipur: The Southern Paradise of India
programme.desc: From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer’s paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises
programme.desc: Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Crescent Lake"
programme.desc: Ash is into the final stretch of his journey along The Great Wall of China. After seeing the building techniques used on the Great Wall, Ash heads into the Gobi Desert to the stunning Cresent Lake – a beautiful oasis between walls of sand.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Seattle"

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Alaska"

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Disney Cruise Line"

programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Vienna, Broome, Barossa Valley

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "New South Wales, Budapest"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 New South Wales, Budapest
programme.desc: Scotty visits the New South Wales south coast while Alana continues her European tour in Budapest while Skye tries her hand at golf in the world-renowned wine region of the Barossa Valley.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Panna: Land of the Dhole"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Panna: Land of the Dhole
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera.

programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Ahmedabad: Land of Gandhi
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Calcutta: City of Living History
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Puerto Rico"
programme.desc: Liesel explores all the hands-on activities such as riding horseback on the beach, riding ATV’s through the muddy swamps, and hiking through the super lush El Yunque rainforest. Luxurious resorts are only a stone's throw away - hopping islands, Liesel gets to experience the ultra modern and chic El Blok located in Vieques. Between stays at all the luxury boutique resorts, a common trend starts to appear, and that is the island’s cuisine.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Hong Kong"
programme.desc: Hong Kong is Asia’s world city and this episode is a complete 360 from the melee of tropical island paradises. Hong Kong is famous for it’s skyscraper strewn skyline and in this episode, local girl Lesley Chiang is on a mission to show a different side of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Belize"
programme.desc: Luxe Travels showcases beautiful Belize; with hundreds of kilometers of coastline with the Caribbean sea, the 2nd largest barrier reef, and one of the best dive sites in the world, how could you not? In this episode, Dani Kristo is on a mission to showcase the best of Belize

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "York"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace explores York’s food and history over 3 days and even adds his own touch to the famous York Minster.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Hard Rock Tampa"
programme.desc: Denella discovers her rhythm at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Amawater Ways Danube"
programme.desc: Denella is in Europe cruising the Danube with AmaWaterways.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Hard Rock Hollywood"

programme.desc: After meeting an old friend from the Chu Great Wall, Ash visits some beautiful stone structures – both natural and human-made – at Yardang National Park and Xiaofang City. With one final phone call home, it's time to leave The Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "South India: Land of Superlatives"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 South India: Land of Superlatives
programme.desc: Two of the greatest ancient monuments in the world are in South India—Hampi and Konark. These two wonders of the world were lost to the west, but now are at the top of many bucket lists.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to...

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. Chengdu lacquerware also emphasizes the use of vibrant colors. Pieces are brought to beautiful life by bright red, vivid yellow, emerald green, and other striking hues.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Selected Programs From the 2026 CMG Spring Festival Gala
programme.desc: The Spring Festival, or Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional holiday for Chinese people. Additionally, watching the Spring Festival Gala is a cherished part of the celebrations across hundreds of millions of Chinese homes.Since first being broadcast in 1983, the gala has been recognized by the Guinness World Records as the most-watched annual television program on the planet. Just over a year ago, the Spring Festival itself was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished.In the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. With time, Corban became more than a religious festival. It developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar.Corban is as important as New Year. Kashgar locals load their tables with food on this day to reward themselves for a year of hard work. Corban is all...

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The taste of bread
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The taste of bread
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 4 - Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of...

programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Nature’s Heroes: Gabon - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Nature’s Heroes: Gabon - Part 1
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Citrus flavors
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: My Zen Trendy - Season 2 - Topanga Canyon, AMBA Yoga

programme.desc: Val goes to the heart of Topanga Canyon, California, a favorite spot for yoga addicts and nature lovers. Here she will experience AMBA Yoga, a kind of hollistic yoga for women. We will also attend a Sound Bowl session, a Tibetan practice considered the ultimate in meditation. In the heart of Venice Beach, we will discover the "Plant Lab", a new high-tech application that records the vibrations of plants to create music. Finally, Val will present us the largest concept store of rare crystals in South America.

programme.title: My Zen Trendy - Season 2 - Hot Springs
programme.desc: Still in Palm Springs, we will discover the Parker Hotel, the most trendy and design hotel in town. A French chef will take us to cook in the middle of nature. Then, Val will go to Desert Springs, a town known for its natural hot springs. At one of the many spas in town, Val will test one of the springs and even attend a Sound Bowl session.

programme.title: My First Garden - Season 1 - Growing mushrooms at home

programme.desc: We meet at the Romainville market garden centre to learn how to grow mushrooms at home. Some varieties, such as button mushrooms, oyster mushrooms or shiitake mushrooms, grow quite easily in mushroom houses. But you too can do it. And today we will show you how to make a miniature version of this kit to grow oyster mushrooms at home.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.sub-title: S04 : E02 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 2, Germany

Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E07 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: Zindagi Ki Mehek is an Indian television drama series that aired from 2016 to 2018. Their paths cross when Mehek participates in a cooking competition that Shaurya is judging. Despite their contrasting personalities and initial conflicts, they fall in love and face numerous challenges together, including family opposition and personal vendettas. The show blends themes of love, family, and ambition with a strong emphasis on culinary arts.

programme.sub-title: S04 : E70 Jodha Akbar S4 E70
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Golden One Center - Sacramento, CA

The excitement continues with the Great Clips Skills Challenge, featuring technical maneuvers and two-wheel stunts. The night reaches its peak during Freestyle, where Blake Granger and Monster Mutt Dalmatian deliver a spectacular performance, including a signature backflip, to sweep the competition. After a fierce battle against top competitors like Matt Cody...

Clean launches, aggressive cornering, and costly mistakes reshape the leaderboard as rivals trade momentum. With points on the line and no room for error, this episode delivers pure Monster Jam intensity from start to finish.

programme.desc: Vicki is the first journalist in the world to drive the astonishing £150,000 Gibbs Aquada, an amphibious car that breaks the mould. Vicki tests it out on the open road and the ocean wave.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i. It's an impressive machine - costing £50,000 it'll do 150mph. Jason Palto tests the ultimate track car, the brand new Lotus 2 Eleven.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jon Bentley is on a mission to discover Britain's Most Prestigious Car. Fifth Gear have commissioned a poll by experts You Gov, and can tonight reveal the results of their 2,000 person survey.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason and Jonny face off in the series' first van versus pick-up challenge. The team test the Cupra Ateca, the first car from Seat's sports division, and Jimmy fits a custom exhaust.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Legendary Hollywood stunt co-ordinator Vic Armstrong teaches Vicki Butler-Henderson, the same stunt he taught Tom Cruise. She has to hit a ramp perfectly to roll the car as a climax to the chase.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff offers a unique behind-the-scenes glimpse of the final British Touring Car Championship race of the year as Jason attempts to clinch the championship, Vicki reveals everything you need to know about Renault's sexy new convertible the Wind.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell and Jason Plato hold a track battle between two executive cars with over 1000bhp between them. The brand new Audi RS6 and Mercedes E63 AMG are both designed to demolish autobahns

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: In this episode of Fifth Gear Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson visit sunny South Africa to drive everything from rally cars, to supercars to military vehicles.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff and Jason hold a knock-out tournament to see if the 570hp Mercedes SLS AMG can beat its rivals from Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar. Jonny meets Swedish rally legend Stig Blomquist for some ice driving lessons in the new Audi A1 Quattro.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell and motoring journalist Chris Harris put two track focused supercars through their paces - the Ferrari 458 Speciale and the Porsche 911 GT3. Tests involving agility, road manners and head to head racing will decide which is best.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: For the first time, Tiff Needell (Fifth Gear founder, ex-Top Gear presenter and racing driver) has brought together his 10 favourite Supercar road tests from the programme in one high octane compilation.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson visit Poland to sample some of the sights, sounds and car culture there. Tiff competes in the final stage of the Barborka Rally, that takes place on the icy streets of Warsaw as night falls.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford drives Volvo's stylish new coupe, the C30; and Tiff Needell tests whether a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' bio-fuel powered Exige 265E.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson tests Ford's Focus ST170 and concludes that it's a good car in a refined sort of way but no rival for the current hot hatch favourite, Honda's Civic Type-R.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason and Tiff take on a dogfight with a difference - racing buses! Jonny invents three practical tests for the new Mercedes E-Class. Tim investigates the Government's new scrappage system. Tom is on a mission in the stunning new Aston Martin.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki finds out how quick the police are on a racing track; Jonny tests small economy cars to find out if they can climb one of Britain's biggest hills; Sarah tries to out manoeuvre Jason in an articulated lorry and Tiff drives the new BMW M3.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell tests the latest car to join the elite ranks of road cars capable of over 200mph includes such mouthwatering prospects as the Enzo Ferrari, the Pagani Zonda, and the Porsche Carerra GT .

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki finds out if the new 207 GTi is as exhilarating to drive as the 20 year old hot hatch the 205GTi; Fifth Gear conducts a fascinating world's first crash test.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jon Bentley investigates how hitting a motorway crash barrier can make your car fly through the air. Jason Plato gives cricketer Kevin Petersen the chance to drive the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson was the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge. Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Adrian Simpson road tests Vauxhall's new Vectra. He finds it very dull to look at inside and out. The 2.2 litre petrol engine feels slow. On the plus side it's better than the model it replaces.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jonny and Tom decide which is best, a diesel Mini or petrol one; Tiff compares the new Subaru Impeza to a previous version and Vicki discovers which is quickest, the British or Japanese version of the Honda Civic Type R.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Fifth Gear Jason Plato drives the awesome 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500; Vicki Butler-Henderson races the ultra-exclusive MINI GP against a 90mph radio controlled car; Tom Ford tests the Skoda Roomster.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff and Jason pit the Volkswagen Scirocco and Mini Cooper S against each other. Green driving is the subject of Jonny's attention as he gets behind the wheel of Honda's Insight hybrid. Tom drives the world's smallest four seater - the Toyota iQ.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford takes puts the Grande Punto Abarth through its hot hatch paces. Tim Shaw finds out if it's possible to save huge amounts of money by servicing your car yourself. Bruno Senna joins the programme as a special guest presenter.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: In the series finale we bring you the ultimate supercar battle when we pitch the awesome McLaren F1 against the almighty Enzo Ferrari. Jason Plato tries his hand at flying a stunt plane.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices - by giving the keys to her sister; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson, Adrian Simpson and Tom Ford visit the Paris motor show. They look at many of the new models revealed there including the Porsche Cayenne and Bentley Continental GT.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jonny Smith goes on a rather expensive road trip - in a £250,000 Rolls Royce Phantom. Tom Ford is testing the new Porsche Cayenne Turbo.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts to drive flat out in Aston Martin's new Vanquish S. The 520bhp, £175,000-plus super-coupe accelerates from 0-60 in 4.8 seconds and is capable of over 200mph.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff drives the Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera Jonny goes to meet another pioneer of alternative fuels - a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar and Tom drives the £260,000 Rolls-Royce Drophead Coupe.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Fifth Gear Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the world's biggest lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is at Anglesey for another Fifth Gear shoot-out. This time it's super chic superminis, the BMW Mini One against the Fiat 500. Jason Plato delivers his verdict on the Nissan Skyline now re-badged as the GT-R.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason pits two almost identical Porsche Caymans. Jonny is enjoying some Spanish sun in the brand new Audi A5 cabriolet. Tim investigates the accuracy of the combined economy cycle. Jason helps Matthew Pinsent find his perfect car.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Do cars explode like they do in the movies? Tiff Needell and Adrian Simpson stage their own car chase and then watch the experts who've worked on James Bond movies take over for the special effects.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tim Shaw is the latest car nut to join the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist. Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head to head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta. Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels. Jonny shows us three great, affordable cars. Jason Plato takes the Porsche 911 GT2 out on the track.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track. Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell employs the help of two models to test the theory that the quicker you drive a convertible, the less your hair blows. He blasts the brand new Bentley Continental GTC up to 150mph.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy; Tom Ford drives the Honda CRV, the SUV that claims to be greener than a MINI Cooper.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford spends the day with the scourge of modern day motorists - wheel clampers. Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest version of one of the greatest coupes of our time, the Nissan 350Z.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Iwan accepts a stunt challenge from world famous precision driver Russ Swift; we observe supercars trying to beat the 0-62 world record; Jonny secretly repairs the potholes that local councils refuse to.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff enters the opening round of the exclusive Lamborghini Super Trofeo race series - with advice from the man with every petrolhead's dream job - Lamborghini chief test driver Giorgio Sanna.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell travel to Romania to sample some of the car culture there. This includes driving some massive off-roaders, meeting a local classic car restorer, and racing a motorsport mad Mayor up the streets of his town.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki is in Denmark experiencing the exciting world of motorbike speedway with triple world champion Nicki Pederson. Jonny visits Ferrari's hi-tech aluminium factory before taking their latest California supercar out for a test drive.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tiff Needell is joined by rally star Kris Meeke for a hot hatch showdown. With four brand new models lined up at the track, they hold a high octane knockout tournament to find which is fastest of all.

programme.desc: Kubra returns home, but peace is short-lived. Yigit is released by Nihat Demir’s men — battered, bleeding, and barely alive.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand un pédophile est retrouvé battu à mort, Andy découvre que Marlo enquêtait sur lui hors du travail. Avec Swarek, ils vont tenter de la couvrir tout en retrouvant le véritable agresseur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand Andy et Chloe essuient les tirs d'un tireur embusqué, les agents de la 15e Division réalisent qu'ils doivent continuer à servir et à protéger la ville tout en étant pris pour cible.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 You Can See the Stars
programme.desc: Suite à une attaque ciblée contre la 15e Division, Andy, Swarek et leurs collègues doivent découvrir la vérité sur un ancien crime à temps pour sauver la vie à Oliver Shaw.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit éprouvante, Andy et Dov essaient de se ressourcer dans un restaurant ciblé par des braqueurs, pendant que la 15e Division tente de limiter les dommages collatéraux.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 All By Her Selfie
programme.desc: Oliver est promu sergent-chef et Andy forme une nouvelle recrue, mais quand ils interviennent ensemble sur un homicide, il semble que cette dernière va représenter un sacré défi pour Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 Heart Breakers, Money Makers
programme.desc: À l'approche de la Fite Nite, la 15e division doit faire de nombreuses saisies, mais Andy demande de l'aide à Nick pour éclaircir des aveux suspects concernant une maison de jeu illégale.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une fusillade mène à la découverte d'un chef de gang exécuté, la 15e Division cherche à éviter qu'une guerre des gangs n'éclate. Andy et Duncan doivent protéger le seul témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, l'intérêt de Chris pour un trafiquant de drogue éveille les soupçons de Dov. Duncan fait des accusations contre Andy, qui décide d'aider Sam dans une sombre affaire.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 Two Truths and a Lie
programme.desc: Andy et Sam décident d'interroger une liste de détenus d'un pénitencier, tous associés au principal suspect du meurtre de Brian Gowdy. Mais l'un d'eux est Jay Swarek, le père de Sam.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: Oliver prépare Andy à se défendre lors de l'audience de licenciement de Duncan, mais ce dernier avançant de nouvelles preuves, Oliver va compromettre son intégrité et son amitié avec Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le problème de dépendance de Chris atteint son paroxysme durant une enquête sur un cambriolage suspect qui révèlera un problème de famille dysfonctionnelle et qui les mettra en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors du déménagement d'un immeuble voué à être détruit, Andy et Chloe découvrent un homme torturé dans un appartement vide, et dévoilent une opération criminelle de grande envergure.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Duncan reprend du service et souhaite se réconcilier avec Andy, qui n'est pas prête. Mais quand une bombe explose dans le centre-ville, la 15e Division doit en arrêter l'auteur au plus vite.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division s'efforce de retrouver Ted Mcdonald, l'auteur de l'attentat à la voiture piégée. Une fois attrapé, ils réalisent qu'il a dispersé d'autres bombes dans la nature.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un mois après l'attentat à la bombe, Andy et Sam reprennent le travail. Mais quand Andy est agressée, la brigade des mœurs entre en conflit avec la 15e Division sur la manière de procéder.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Avec la grossesse de Marlo, Andy remet en doute son avenir avec Sam, mais son idée de la famille parfaite est remise en question quand elle rencontre une ado à la famille conservatrice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'un transfert, une émeute éclate dans une prison pour femmes. Andy et Juliet se retrouvent alors prises au piège avec une détenue qui veut à tout prix prouver son innocence.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le frère de Nick apparaît avec des informations sur une personne de leur passé, Nick décide de traquer l'homme en question, mais Juliet est sur ses talons.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division craint qu'un célèbre trafiquant d'armes n'ait kidnappé Traci, mais quand Andy réalise que c'est l'œuvre du violeur en série qui leur a échappé, tout le monde est mobilisé.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après une fusillade lors d'un match de baseball, la relation entre Gail et son frère est mise à l'épreuve. Pendant ce temps, Swarek planifie une escapade avec Andy, qui s'avère surprenante.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Sam sont choqués d'apprendre qu'Oliver est le principal suspect d'une affaire de corruption au sein de la 15e Division, et n'ont que jusqu'à la fin de la journée pour le disculper.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Oliver est toujours le principal suspect de l'attentat à la bombe, Andy, Dov, Gail et Nick entreprennent un plan risqué pour prouver que le commissaire Alonso Santana est corrompu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur frappe la ville, et le commissariat sert de station de rafraîchissement au public. Andy et Marlo recherchent une patiente disparue quand Marlo commence à accoucher.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E21 Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Andy vit mal l'arrivée de la fille de Sam et Marlo, et songe accepter une mission de quatre mois hors de la ville. Pendant ce temps, Jarvis annonce que la 15e Division va être restructurée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le jour de son mariage avec Sam, Andy découvre un homme mourant sur la route, sans possibilité d'appeler qui que ce soit. Parviendra-t-elle à le sauver et à se rendre à son mariage à temps ?

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le triomphe se transforme en humiliation lorsqu'une opération tourne mal et qu'Andy McNally, nouvelle recrue de la police, arrête l'un des siens et ruine une opération d'infiltration.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les autres se lancent à la recherche d'un détenu, Swarek parle à Andy de ses exploits. Alors qu'ils se lancent à la poursuite d'un informateur danger, et une étincelle jaillit.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy doit enfreindre le protocole afin de gagner la confiance d'une victime qui a été déçue par le système, alors que les autres recrues s'affrontent pour une cause lors de la "Fite Nite".

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy se fait passer pour une prostituée. La tension monte lorsque Dov met la vie d'une informatrice en danger et qu'Andy doit infiltrer un réseau de trafic d'armes pour la sauver.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un cambriolage dans un quartier huppé mobilise toutes les jeunes recrues, mais une fois la scène inspectée, Andy se retrouve seule face à un voleur caché, armé et particulièrement instable.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une collision mortelle révèle une vérité choquante, et la romance entre Andy et l'inspecteur Luke Callaghan se complique lorsqu'ils sont en désaccord sur la manière de traiter un témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur fait des ravages, sans compter la présence d'un violeur en série. Dans ce chaos, une panne de courant générale force Andy à s'attaquer seule à ce dangereux prédateur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Chris enquêtent sur une agression, mais quand tous les indices mènent à un policier, ils doivent prendre une décision qui pourrait mettre leur carrière en péril.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Girlfriend of the Year
programme.desc: Chris et Gail découvrent une voiture accidentée correspondant à une alerte enlèvement. Une chasse à l'homme débute et l'interrogatoire des parents de l’enfant révèle des indices troublants.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La tension est palpable entre Andy et Swarek, mais ils doivent mettre leurs sentiments de côté lorsqu'un transfert de prisonnier qui tourne mal finit en chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 To Serve or Protect
programme.desc: Le père d'Andy, ancien flic, pense avoir commis un crime durant un trou de mémoire dû à l'alcool, et en se penchant sur l'affaire, elle est confrontée à l'éventualité de l'envoyer en prison.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: C'est le jour de l'évaluation pour les recrues, qui vont connaître l'avenir réservé à leur carrière. Mais le meurtre d'une jeune fille bouleverse Andy qui songe à rendre son insigne.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une arrestation prématurée compromet une importante saisie de drogue, Andy tente de s'infiltrer avec Swarek. Mais un changement de plan radical met leur vie en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La vie d'Andy bascule quand elle reçoit une balle perdue lors d'une fusillade qui ôte la vie à une étudiante. En cherchant une explication, Andy entre en conflit avec une nouvelle détective.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Gail jouent les serveuses afin de démanteler un trafic de drogue, Traci lutte contre ses sentiments pour Jerry, et Dov et Chris entrent en désaccord concernant une plainte.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un vol de têtes coupées, Andy et Swarek retrouvent la trace d'un homme mentalement instable, et exposent malencontreusement Luke à de terribles conséquences.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une série d'incendies frappe une laverie. Chris et Gail rencontrent un homme lié au passé de Chris, Traci interroge une jeune incendiaire, et Andy se retrouve piégée dans les flammes.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un criminel donne une info qui pousse Dov et Chris dans une maison piégée. Traci et Andy font ce qu'elles peuvent pour une suspecte SDF. Luke et Jo travaillent ensemble sur une surveillance.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un informateur est retrouvé assassiné. Andy fait équipe avec l'inspectrice Jo Rosati, qui semble bien intéressée par Luke. Gail doit protéger un jeune témoin qui cache un lourd secret.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Une femme est agressée à l'identique qu'une recrue décédée, et Luke Callaghan est sûr qu'il s'agit du même suspect. Mais comme on lui retire l'affaire, il convainc Andy de suivre sa théorie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division est sous quarantaine. Andy et Swarek cherchent le complice d'un braqueur. Gail a été exposée à un malade, Chris infiltre une cellule et Dov a rendez-vous avec une démineuse.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov et Gail tentent d'empêcher un gang chinois d'assassiner un mouchard. Andy et Chris rejoignent les recrues de la 27ème Division lors d'un entraînement équin pour le moins compétitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La traque d'un ravisseur mène la 15e Division sur les lieux d'un accident de voiture. Pendant qu'Andy s'occupe d'une femme coincée dans sa voiture, les autres agents poursuivent le fugitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, Traci et Andy tombent sur une femme faisant une overdose, et Dov rencontre un vieil ami. Chris et Gail s'occupent d'un adolescent retrouvé ligoté dans un cimetière.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait voler son uniforme. Swarek tente d'obtenir des informations d'un ancien membre de la police criminelle, mais son incapacité à rester éloigné d'Andy compromet l'opération.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que Swarek est violemment interrogé par Jamie Brennan dans le sous-sol d'une ferme, les recrues aident Andy à résoudre un mystère qui pourrait révéler l'endroit où il se trouve.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle se rend à son audience, Andy, toujours suspendue, fait le lien entre une jeune fille qui disparaît mystérieusement du lieu d'un accident et une ancienne affaire non résolue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les lycées s'apprêtent à fermer pour l'été, une voiture de police armée est volée. Andy et Swarek recherchent un adolescent instable qui a agressé le père de sa petite amie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov est témoin d'un vol et abat un jeune adolescent noir. A-t-il fait usage d'une force justifiable ? Quand la nouvelle se répand dans le quartier, les choses s'enveniment.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une voiture remplie de jeunes filles percute un autre véhicule et tue la conductrice. Quand Jerry découvre que l'autre conducteur était mort avant l'accident, il retire l'affaire à Traci.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Andy se retrouve obligée de travailler en étroite collaboration avec sa mère qui l'a abandonnée, Swarek, Nick, Chris et Gail recherchent une mère de famille désespérée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Swarek découvrent un SDF poignardé et un témoin surprenant : Izzy, la fille d'Oliver, âgée de 15 ans. Son implication pousse Oliver à la frontière entre son rôle de père et de flic.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un soi-disant médium veut aider la 15e Division à retrouver un témoin dans une affaire de crime organisé, les policiers se retrouvent confrontés à certaines vérités cachées.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une enquête sur une série de disparitions d'escort-girls, Gail part en infiltration. Mais Dov et Chris découvrent qu'il s'agit de l'œuvre d'un tueur qui pourrait s'en prendre à Gail.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait enlever par un possible tueur en série. En suivant les pistes d'affaires similaires, les agents retrouvent les traces du meurtrier, mais sont contraints de faire un sacrifice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un ordinateur de la police contenant des informations sensibles est volé, les recrues, encore choquées de la mort d'un des leurs, découvrent qu'un informateur risque d'être compromis.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un prêtre menacé de mort par un trafiquant de drogue local, Andy and Nick réalisent que ses relations surprenantes risquent de les mener sur un terrain glissant.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une garde, un prisonnier braque une arme sur Chris. Alors que les affaires internes cherchent un coupable, les recrues cherchent le juste milieu entre dire la vérité et se soutenir.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un pédophile évadé lors d'un transfert enlève une jeune fille, Andy et Sam le traquent et se retrouvent dans un face-à-face mortel aboutissant à une véritable catharsis émotionnelle.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après six mois d'infiltration, Andy et Nick disparaissent l’un après l'autre. Pendant ce temps, Sam Swarek et les autres agents mènent une enquête qui tourne vite à la mission de sauvetage.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dès son retour, Andy travaille avec Swarek pour retrouver un ancien détenu, et réalise à quel point les choses ont changé depuis qu'elle s'est éloignée de son ancienne vie, il y a six mois.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy fait équipe avec la nouvelle petite amie de Swarek. Quand elles se retrouvent face à un homme hors de contrôle, leurs différences sont mises à l'épreuve et l'une d'elles doit faire feu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 The Kids Are Not Alright
programme.desc: Andy rêve d'un long week-end bien mérité, mais lorsqu'elle découvre un adolescent dans le coffre d'une voiture, elle cherche à le convaincre qu'aucun chagrin d'amour ne dure éternellement.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Marlo se retrouvent mises en quarantaine alors que la 15e Division se mobilise pour nettoyer les rues d'une drogue contaminée avant qu'une épidémie mortelle ne s'abatte sur la ville.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une jeune fille est portée disparue, la police découvre un lien avec une ancienne affaire délicate. Gail, elle, doit affronter ses pires peurs pour retrouver la jeune fille disparue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand des ossements humains retrouvés rouvrent une enquête vieille de 15 ans, Swarek se rapproche de son ancien instructeur et devra décider s'il veut continuer à suivre ses traces ou non.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 For Better, for Worse
programme.desc: La 15e Division souhaite passer une journée facile avant le mariage de Frank et Noelle, mais les choses tournent mal quand un bus de personnes âgées est attaqué et que la mariée disparaît.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le fils de Chris se fait enlever, la 15e Division met tout en œuvre pour le retrouver. Mais quand il est ramené à la maison, Chris fait face à une révélation difficile.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une descente dans une plantation de cannabis débouche sur la première affaire d'homicide de Traci, pendant que Swarek, Oliver, Chris et Dov partent passer une journée entre hommes.

programme.desc: Ridge tries to seduce Margo. Donna apologizes to Rocco. Kristen enjoys her blind date with Chuck.

Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

(The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control...
